bounding: Every company at each shared registered address in the joined registers that holds a Legal Entity Identifier, counted by intersecting two complete enumerations: the register clusters (Companies House register snapshot 2026-08-01; Enhetsregisteret snapshot 2026-08-22) and every LEI in the GLEIF Global LEI Index golden copy of 2026-08-22 whose registration authority is that register. Foreign parentage comes from the GLEIF relationship records of 2026-08-23, counting only ACTIVE direct and ultimate consolidation links whose parent is in a different jurisdiction, and is counted against the LEI HOLDERS at each address rather than against every company there — most companies at these addresses hold no LEI, so nothing is known about their ownership either way. Dated 2026-08-01, the older of the inputs, because a joined count is only as current as its stalest part. Complete within that boundary. Holding an LEI means an entity with that registration number appears in the LEI index; it does not mean the company trades, is regulated, or is active at all.
